verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the same OSS codebase can run your own relay (VISION.md). The docs ship a single-node/VPS compose bundle and a Helm chart with production (HA, external Postgres/Redis/S3) and quickstart profiles that need no external services. A probe confirmed the GHCR chart is published (versions 0.1.1–0.1.8). Missing for 10: independent or community hands-on report of a successful self-hosted deployment.
